usageNotes: Use this endpoint to inspect a VM's configuration diff — it returns every config key alongside its current live value and any pending value that will take effect after the next VM reboot. This is the right call before rebooting a VM to confirm what changes are queued, or after editing config to verify the pending state was recorded correctly. Requires VM.Audit permission on /vms/{vmid}; the node must be online.

examples.summary: Check pending configuration changes on VM 105 before a scheduled reboot

tips: A row with only 'value' (no 'pending') means that key has no queued changes.
A row with 'delete' set to 1 means the key is queued for removal on next reboot; value 2 means a force-delete is pending.
A row with 'pending' but no 'value' means the key is being added for the first time.
Compare 'value' vs 'pending' on the 'memory' or 'cores' keys to confirm a resize will take effect without a live migration.
If there are no pending changes, the response array will still list all current config keys with only 'value' populated.
